assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service is medically necessary to document and correlate the patient's palpitations and dizziness with potential arrhythmias.
The service is documented in the clinical indication note for this service.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved.
The patient has a diagnosis of R00.2.
The patient has a diagnosis of R42.
